name: flaggems_igammac_
description: In-place regularized upper incomplete gamma function igammac_ (a.igammac_(x)). Correctness uses positive rand()+0.1 float32 inputs via a custom generator; the reference upcasts copies to float64, computes igammac_, casts back into the mutated first input a. Timing uses BinaryPointwiseBenchmark's generic float32 random inputs.
